decided: A change's account of what it built is first written when the change's building work is complete, and rewritten only while that stays true: a review walk of the finished change rewrites it when a fix changes what it says, and when a review reopens work, the account is rewritten once, when that work is finished again, so the program brief always describes finished work.
alternatives: rewrite the account in every building session whose work changes what it says, finished or not
why: The user chose it at the walk: one rule covers the first account and every rewrite, and the brief never shows half-done work.
